title: Exception-question passes in a release comparison
method: Synthetic paired evaluation slice containing 20 exception questions. Existing pass rate is 16/20 = 80%; proposed pass rate is 10/20 = 50%. Routine questions are reported separately in the text. No confidence interval or causal claim is implied.
alt: Exception-question passes in a release comparison. Existing system: 16 passed cases out of 20, Proposed change: 10 passed cases out of 20. Illustrative data.
